mechanics.claim: Spectral Maw resets Viego's basic attack timer on the recast blast.
mechanics.quote: Spectral Maw {{tip|Basic attack reset|resets}} '''Viego's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The recast dashes and hurls a mist blast that deals damage and stuns only the first enemy hit.
mechanics.quote: hurls a blast of mist in the target direction and {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the same direction, though not through terrain. The mist deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: Viego can cast any of his other abilities during the dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Viego''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

mechanics.claim: During the charge Viego is slowed by 10%, which is a defensive/mobility penalty not affecting outgoing damage directly.
If the charge completes without a recast, the ability is cancelled and placed on full cooldown instead of firing.
mechanics.quote: If the charge completes without reactivation, ''Spectral Maw'' is cancelled and placed on {{sti|full cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts when the channel ends (i.e., after the recast or cancellation), not on initial cast.
While charging, Blade of the Ruined King and Heartbreaker are disabled, but basic attacks and Harrowed Path can still be used.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Harrowed Path|Viego}} is usable. {{ai|Blade of the Ruined King|Viego}} and {{ai|Heartbreaker|Viego}} are disabled.
